title: Rose Petal Sorbet With Blackberry Jam

ingredientSections.heading: Rose Petal Sorbet With Blackberry Jam
items: 3 Cups rose petals, grown organically or unsprayed from your backyard (or your neighbours when they aren’t looking)

methodSections.heading: Rose Petal Sorbet With Blackberry Jam
steps: Combine the sugar, rose petals and vanilla bean scrape in food processor and process until paste forms.
Add the water, lemon juice and champagne and pulse to combine.
Strain the mixture into a bowl and add the jam, stirring gently to just combine.
Transfer to an ice cream maker and follow the manufacturer’s directions.
If you don’t have a ice cream maker, transfer into a 20cm (8in) square pan and place in freezer. Every 15 minutes, scrape the mixture with a fork until a perfect sorbet consistency forms.
Serve with a dollop of jam and fresh rose petals.
